$comment: PRIVATE calibration map. Scores are computed from three sub-scores (0-10 each) weighted and summed, then mapped to the public tier. These numbers NEVER appear in the PR — only the tier icon/label does. See docs/CALIBRATION.md.

question.$comment: A pass-2 'question' is a concern the verifier could NOT confirm from the code — its tier must never exceed maxTier, whatever the finder scored it. A real PR on a private app repo: a speculative 'login might outrun init()' question posted as Major on a false premise.
